text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَٰكِهُونَ

words.gloss_range: emphatic clause-opening particle that governs the following subject and asserts the garden-state as established fact

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governed subject and predicate field asserted by the particle

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens the ayah as confirmation, not as a loose scene-setting particle. It governs {{ar:أَصْحَٰبَ}} ({{tr:aṣḥāba}}) and throws emphatic scope over the state that follows, so the companions' absorption and delight are presented as established news after the judgment register of 36:54. Its scope may close at the end of 36:55 or continue into 36:56, but locally it makes the garden-state a settled proposition, and its dense doubled sound matches the tightening grammatical launch.

topics.headline: emphatic particle makes the state established
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the garden description is asserted as a confirmed state, not merely introduced as scenery.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the opening as an emphatic particle governing the subject and licensing the following predicate field.

topics.headline: fresh clause pivots from judgment to bliss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah boundary turns the prior legal reckoning into a new emphatic report about the sorted garden group.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows make the particle a boundary marker after 36:54, while attachment evidence allows the local clause to stand as an emphatic nominal unit.

words.gloss_range: companions, associates, or people characterized by a durable relation; locally the construct phrase selects the garden-companion class
words.root_gloss_range: broad companionship and association field, with possession or inhabiting pressure only as part of the relational range, not as a separate local predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the emphatic particle that governs the companion group
the definite genitive complement that identifies the companion group

words.prose: {{ar:أَصْحَٰبَ}} ({{tr:aṣḥāba}}) is not a bare plural label. As the governed noun of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), it is routed through emphatic assertion; as the construct head before {{ar:ٱلْجَنَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-jannati}}), it defines the group by durable affiliation with the garden. The root's companionship range gives the phrase more than residence, though local grammar narrows that range to garden-belonging rather than activating ownership as an independent claim. The formula also sorts the discourse into the wider garden/fire destiny binary (2:82; 2:39), while contrasting earlier same-surah uses of people-groups such as the city's companions (36:13) and the refusal scene of 36:47.

topics.headline: governed subject becomes a sorted class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first installs a classified group before revealing its timed state.
topics.reason: The word is accusative as the governed subject of the emphatic particle, and the sequence names the class before the temporal and predicate material.

topics.headline: construct phrase defines them by the garden
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the companions' identity depends grammatically on the garden relation, not on a standalone group name.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the construct relation with the following definite garden noun, matching the high idafa profile for this form.

topics.headline: companionship range becomes durable affiliation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase carries continuous association with the garden, while the local construct prevents the broader possession range from becoming a separate scene claim.
topics.reason: The root range supports companionship and association, but the local idafa selects identity-by-affiliation rather than three fully independent senses.

topics.headline: formulaic destiny class enters the scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase belongs to a Quranic classification formula and, within this surah, reverses earlier group scenes (36:13; 36:47).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give formula and same-surah references, while the local phrase is exactly the construct pattern that supports the classification reading.

words.gloss_range: the definite garden or paradise as the genitive domain completing the companion formula
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealment, shielding, and related hiddenness images; locally realized as the protected garden-domain, not as every branch of the root family

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the construct head completed by the garden noun

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجَنَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-jannati}}) completes the subject phrase as a genitive complement, so the garden is not a second predicate but the domain through which the companions are identified. Its definiteness makes the domain known and singular in this formula. The root's covering and concealment field remains useful because the garden is imagined as a protected, screened domain, but that pressure is narrowed to the local paradise noun. Within the surah, this returns the garden language from individual entry (36:26) and earthly garden signs (36:34) into a settled collective state.

topics.headline: genitive garden completes the class name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the garden defines the group before any state is predicated of them.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive as the idafa complement and definite, so it completes the recognized garden-companion phrase.

topics.headline: covering image becomes protected paradise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the protected and screened texture of the garden noun while keeping paradise as the selected local sense.
topics.reason: The root family supports concealment and covering pressure, but local grammar and the concrete noun form select the paradise/garden domain.

topics.headline: garden language returns as settled state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from entry and sign-gardens (36:26; 36:34) to the companions' established garden state.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete same-surah references, and no reference evidence blocks using them as local echo rather than controlling parse.

words.gloss_range: the definite day as an accusative temporal frame, locally the recognized eschatological day repeated from the prior ayah
words.root_gloss_range: day, event-time, or bounded period; locally an identified judgment-day frame that can support an extended state without making the word indefinite
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْيَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-yawma}}) is an accusative time adverb placed between the named group and its state. That insertion makes the reader wait: identity is fixed, the day is fixed, then occupation and delight appear. Because the same definite day-marker has just carried the no-wronging judgment of 36:54, its reuse here binds justice and delight inside one recognized eschatological frame. The root can cover a bounded event-period, so the pleasure-state need not be reduced to a brief daily activity, but the local form remains the definite day rather than an indefinite era.

topics.headline: inserted day-marker delays the state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sequence identity, day, then state, rather than hearing the predicate arrive immediately.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as an accusative temporal adverb attached to the predicate field.

topics.headline: same day holds justice and joy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the day of 36:54 becomes, for this group, the day of delight in 36:55.
topics.reason: The definite form and same-surah repetition support a shared temporal frame with divergent experiences.

topics.headline: day range allows duration without losing definiteness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the timed state can be eschatologically extended while still being anchored to this definite day.
topics.reason: The root range supports event-period breadth, while the local article and accusative adverbial form keep the reference definite.

topics.headline: time frames the predicate routing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the day can frame both occupation and delight, while the PP and participle still allow a tighter occupation-focused route.
topics.reason: Attachment rows license the adverbial relation to the predicate while the local PP plus participle structure leaves more than one grammatical routing possible.

words.gloss_range: preposition of containment, locally circumstantial immersion in a state rather than simple physical location

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the genitive complement governed by the preposition
the final participle whose delight is routed with the prepositional phrase

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) gives the state its container logic. It governs {{ar:شُغُلٍۢ}} ({{tr:shughulin}}), so the companions are not simply performing an activity; they are placed within an occupation as their condition. Because the complement is abstract, the spatial value is narrowed into circumstantial immersion, but the image of being inside still matters. The PP comes before {{ar:فَٰكِهُونَ}} ({{tr:fākihūn}}), making absorption the first predicate frame before delight is named, while the grammar can also route delight as occurring inside that occupation.

topics.headline: spatial containment becomes state immersion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition makes occupation feel like an enveloping condition, not a flat activity label.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the gerund as its complement; because the complement is not a physical place, the spatial sense is preserved as circumstantial containment.

topics.headline: PP routes occupation and delight together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar can read as two predicates or as delight within occupation, making the relation between work and joy part of the ayah's effect.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses the PP as predicative and keeps the participle available as either a second predicate or circumstance.

topics.headline: preposition narrows from day into occupation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the line move from the broad day-marker into the inner occupation before delight closes the phrase.
topics.reason: The standalone preposition visibly and audibly introduces the predicative PP before the final participle.

words.gloss_range: an unspecified occupation or absorption, locally a pleasurable state that contains the companions rather than a named task
words.root_gloss_range: occupying, engaging, diverting, or preoccupying attention; locally revalued as paradisiacal absorption, not anxious distraction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the containment preposition that governs the occupation
the delight participle that qualifies the occupation
a qiraat vowel-pattern variant that preserves the occupation referent
a qiraat vowel-pattern variant that preserves the occupation referent
a qiraat vowel-pattern variant that preserves the occupation referent

words.prose: {{ar:شُغُلٍۢ}} ({{tr:shughulin}}) is the ayah's unnamed center: a singular indefinite verbal noun governed by {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}). The wording does not list pleasures or name a task; it turns being occupied into the state that contains the garden-companions. That is why the root's ordinary attention-capturing force is important, but it is locally revalued by the garden setting and by {{ar:فَٰكِهُونَ}} ({{tr:fākihūn}}): unlike the negative preoccupation of 48:11, this is pleasurable absorption. Its rare gerund form is load-bearing, and qiraat variants such as {{ar:شُغْلٍ}} ({{tr:shughlin}}), {{ar:شَغَلٍ}} ({{tr:shaghalin}}), and {{ar:شَغْلٍ}} ({{tr:shaghlin}}) make the vowel pattern a pressure point while preserving occupation as the referent.

topics.headline: indefinite verbal noun makes absorption the scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah makes absorption itself the reward-medium instead of cataloging particular activities.
topics.reason: The local form is an indefinite gerund governed by the preposition and functioning inside the predicative state frame.

topics.headline: distraction root becomes paradisiacal absorption
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same root field that can describe worldly diversion (48:11) is inverted here into a positive medium of delight.
topics.reason: The root's supplied counterpart at 48:11 supports contrast, while local pairing with the delight participle selects positive absorption.

topics.headline: rare gerund carries the load
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this exact gerund form is marked and load-bearing for the paradise state-description.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the exact gerund form as a one-instance form, matching the CRITICAL rarity claims.

topics.headline: vowel variants test form, not referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitational form shifts make the word audible as a pressure point while leaving the occupation-sense stable.
topics.reason: The variant rows are useful as form contrast, but they do not replace the local surface or change the selected sense.

topics.headline: dense sound resolves into delight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact sound of the occupation and the open tanwin before the final delight-word closes the line.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows describe surface and cadence effects that cohere with the local progression from indefinite occupation to final participial closure.

words.gloss_range: delighting, enjoying, or being characterized by pleasurable ease; locally an active participial state of the garden-companions
words.root_gloss_range: delight, amusement, pleasant enjoyment, and fruit-field pressure; locally delight is selected while the nearby fruit echo keeps concrete pleasure in view

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the same-root fruit noun that appears at 36:57
an accusative variant that would make circumstantial parsing explicit
an accusative variant that would make circumstantial parsing explicit
a short-form variant that tests inherent delighted character

words.prose: {{ar:فَٰكِهُونَ}} ({{tr:fākihūn}}) closes the ayah by naming the affective quality of the occupation: the companions are delighting. Its nominative form supports predicate force; the accusative variants {{ar:فَاكِهِينَ}} ({{tr:fākihīna}}) and {{ar:فَكِهِينَ}} ({{tr:fakihīna}}) show how a circumstantial reading would become explicit. Either way, delight belongs to the rational plural companions, not to the garden or the occupation by itself. The active participle makes delight an ongoing characterization, and {{ar:فَكِهُونَ}} ({{tr:fakihūna}}) tests how inherent that quality sounds. The root also keeps fruit and enjoyment close together, and the same surah soon makes that concrete with {{ar:فَٰكِهَةٌ}} ({{tr:fākiha}}) at 36:57, so the final word points from present delight toward a realized garden provision.

topics.headline: nominative delight tests predicate and circumstance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final participle can assert delight as a predicate while variant evidence shows how a circumstantial route would change the grammar.
topics.reason: The local nominative supports predicate status, while variant and attachment evidence are useful as contrast without overriding the canonical parse.

topics.headline: plural ending assigns delight to the companions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that delight is grammatically attached to the rational plural companions, not vaguely to the scene.
topics.reason: The masculine sound plural ending agrees with the companion group and closes the ayah with rational-plural state marking.

topics.headline: participle makes delight ongoing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that delight is a continuing characterization, while qiraat pressure can intensify inherent quality without changing the local delight sense.
topics.reason: The active participle supports ongoing characterization; variant rows are preserved as form pressure rather than replacement of the local surface.

topics.headline: delight points toward fruit-field realization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the delight-word is not abstract only; the same root soon becomes fruit at 36:57.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give a concrete same-surah root echo at 36:57, and lexical evidence allows delight and fruit-field pressure to remain mutually live.

topics.headline: closing word resolves occupation as delight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on named delight, making the prior unnamed occupation read as positive recompense after 36:54.
topics.reason: The final participle completes the PP-plus-participle state frame and bridges the previous recompense ayah into concrete delight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction fī shughulin is followed by fākihūn.
baseline_models.mechanism: Shughul supplies non-vacancy and absorption without naming an object, while f-k-h supplies the pleasant quality of that absorption.

activation_trace.role: Occupation as the contrary of vacancy makes the state engrossing while leaving its activity unspecified.
Pleasantness, joy, and enjoyed ease supply the positive manner of the unnamed occupation.

changed_reading.before: The Garden's companions are simply happy.
changed_reading.after: The Garden's companions are engrossed in an unnamed engagement whose enacted quality is delight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Aṣḥāba l-jannati defines the people through companionship with a garden.
baseline_models.mechanism: Durable accompaniment joins a place whose branch field combines cultivated enclosure, concealment, and protection, so location becomes a mode of belonging.

activation_trace.role: Companionship and continued attachment make the group more than occupants at a temporary location.
A garden screened by its growth supplies the group's cultivated and enclosing place.
The protective shield image gives the enclosing place a latent function of refuge.

changed_reading.before: They are residents located in the Garden.
changed_reading.after: They are a collective whose identity is sustained attachment to a cultivated, screened, and potentially protective domain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-yawma stands inside the emphatic nominal declaration and scopes the present state.
baseline_models.mechanism: The day can be a temporal duration and, more pointedly, a severe event; placing delight inside that marked now creates a latent contrast between crisis and their condition.

activation_trace.role: A bounded duration makes the companions' condition presently realized rather than timelessly described.
The day as a grave occurrence supplies a possible crisis-background against which their delight stands out.
Enjoyed ease supplies the condition asserted within the marked day.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers a timeless picture of heavenly happiness.
changed_reading.after: It announces a presently realized condition of delight on a marked, potentially severe event-day.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Fākihūn can carry pleasant enjoyment, fruit, and pleasing conversation within the unspecified shughul.
baseline_models.mechanism: The open object of occupation permits material fruition and convivial speech to remain live specifications of the delight without selecting either one.

activation_trace.role: The unspecified occupation provides a slot that more concrete f-k-h branches could fill.
Fruit and choice produce supply a possible material content for the occupation.
Pleasant talk and mutual joking supply a possible social and verbal content.

changed_reading.before: Fākihūn reports an abstract emotional state.
changed_reading.after: The adjective may compress a fruitive and convivial mode of activity, though the focus alone leaves both branches open.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence moves from being stirred out of repose, through collective gathering and presentation, into shughul; occupation therefore reads as recovered, activated life rather than ordinary busyness.

activation_trace.role: Non-vacant absorption names the active endpoint of the sequence.
Stirring the still from its repose supplies the transition from latency into action.
Sleep and stillness provide the state that the later occupation reverses.
Gathering dispersed persons supplies collective reconstitution before differentiated conditions appear.
Presence and nearness make the reconstituted group fully available for the ensuing state.

structural_cues: 36:51-55 advances from trumpet, graves, and a resting place to universal presentation, recompense, and then the focus occupation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rest-to-awakening-to-presence sequence; I infer that shughul marks its positive active endpoint. A live alternative is that the sequence only dates the occupation and does not characterize it.

changed_reading.before: Shughul is generic busyness or diversion.
changed_reading.after: Shughul is the absorbed activity of life reactivated after stillness and collective reconstitution.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated al-yawm frames recompense, delighted occupation, separation, and exposure to fire as simultaneous allotted conditions; the focus is one side of an enacted judicial partition.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day anchors the focus condition in a consequential present.
The companions' absorbing condition becomes one judicially differentiated mode of being.
The same event-day directly introduces the rule of non-wronging and recompense.
Action met by its corresponding return supplies the judicial allocation mechanism.
Intentional action supplies what the recompense answers.
Sorting until one group is distinct from another makes the partition explicit.
A second al-yawm binds separation to the same consequential present as the focus.
Encountering the fire supplies the opposed condition allocated after separation.
The repeated event-day synchronizes the opposed outcome with the companions' delight.

structural_cues: The focus sits between the general recompense rule and the command that the criminals separate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal repetition, recompense, separation, and opposed outcomes; I infer that the repeated day is performative and partitions conditions. The live alternative is simple temporal anaphora with no special distributive force.

changed_reading.before: Today merely dates a pleasant scene.
changed_reading.after: Today is the enacted judicial present in which delighted absorption is allotted to one collective while another is separated into an opposed condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah specifies pairing, protective shade, couches, and reclining; this turns occupation from exertive labor into sustained, relational repose that is still full rather than vacant.

activation_trace.role: Non-vacancy permits a fully absorbing state even when its bodily form is repose.
Companionship prepares the occupation to be read relationally rather than as isolated pleasure.
One partner joined to another supplies the shared form of the focus occupation.
Shade as shelter and protection supplies the environmental support for untroubled repose.
The couch in an enclosure gives the occupation a concrete setting of settled ease.
Reclining through support supplies the bodily action that paradoxically fills the non-vacant state.

structural_cues: 36:56 begins with an emphatic resumption of the same group, then enumerates their companions, environment, furniture, and posture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a direct continuation centered on paired reclining; I infer that it concretizes shughul as engrossing shared repose. A live alternative is that reclining is only the setting for an otherwise unspecified occupation.

changed_reading.before: Occupation suggests active labor or diversion.
changed_reading.after: Their occupation is a full, shared mode of repose: relationally engaged, sheltered, and supported rather than idle or laboring.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier mature fruit and eating, followed immediately by fākihah and unrestricted calling or claiming, literalize the f-k-h adjective as fruitive enjoyment without exhausting its emotional sense.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant delight remains the predicated quality of the companions.
The fruit branch allows the adjective's delight to acquire material content.
Mature fruit establishes fruition as a prior material sign in the surah.
Eating turns produced fruit into enjoyed provision rather than mere scenery.
The explicit fruit noun immediately repeats the focus root and concretizes one dimension of fākihūn.
Calling by speech supplies responsive access to what is desired alongside the fruit.

structural_cues: The adjective fākihūn in 36:55 is followed one ayah later by the cognate noun fākihah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the cognate adjacency and an earlier fruit-eating sign; I infer deliberate semantic literalization from delight into fruitive enjoyment. The live alternative is ordinary lexical repetition that lists fruit without defining the adjective.

changed_reading.before: Fākihūn names only an inward mood.
changed_reading.after: Their delight is fruitive and enacted: inward pleasantness takes material form in fruit and responsive access to what they call for.

context_deltas.mechanism: The f-k-h branch of pleasant conversation is activated by the following speech-act of peace from a merciful Lord, making delighted occupation receptive and relational rather than mute.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant conversation and social wit supply a latent verbal dimension to fākihūn.
Peace as freedom from harm supplies the content and effect of the address.
Articulated speech makes the ensuing peace an event of address rather than a silent condition.
Merciful tenderness gives the address its relational source and benevolent force.

structural_cues: 36:58 is a verbless, concentrated speech declaration immediately after the companions' fruit and claims.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immediate merciful utterance of peace; I infer that it activates the conversational branch of f-k-h and belongs to the companions' experienced occupation. A live alternative is that the utterance is an added gift, not a specification of shughul.

changed_reading.before: The companions enjoy a private or silent pleasure.
changed_reading.after: Their delighted absorption is open to address and relation, crowned by speech that enacts peace.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first names a collective by attachment to a town, then narrates one person's entry into the Garden through forgiveness and honor, and finally names the Garden's companions; the repeated place-defined form creates a civic-to-protected-domain reversal.

activation_trace.role: Continued companionship makes the focus group an identity attached to its place.
The screened garden supplies the new domain that defines the collective.
The same companionship noun first establishes a collective identified by attachment to another place.
A village as a gathered human settlement supplies the earlier civic domain.
Entry into an interior supplies the narrative crossing from exposed civic action into the Garden.
The same screened garden appears first as the entered destination of an individual witness.
Covering the fault and protecting its bearer supplies the condition attached to entry.
Honored nobility supplies the status into which the entrant is placed.

structural_cues: Aṣḥāba l-qaryati in 36:13 and aṣḥāba l-jannati in 36:55 share the same place-defined collective construction.
36:26-27 places an individual entry into the Garden between those two collective labels.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated syntax and a narrated entry; I infer a structural reversal from contested civic belonging to protected, honored belonging. This does not claim that the two collectives are the same people, and the live alternative is that the recurrence is only formulaic naming.

changed_reading.before: Companions of the Garden is a generic label for its residents.
changed_reading.after: It is a culminating place-defined collective identity, structurally answering the earlier town collective and expanding one honored entrant into a communal horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fruit, work, hands, calling, divine hand-work, and ownership form a distributed agency pattern: the companions' shughul can be participatory enjoyment within provision, neither passive receipt nor self-originating production.

activation_trace.role: Occupation anchors the model in exercised agency rather than a merely possessed state.
Fruit supplies the enjoyed yield around which agency and provision interact.
Mature fruit supplies the yield available for use.
Purposive work introduces the question of whether the yield is made, handled, or received.
What hands earn supplies a concrete human-agency pole while the syntax leaves its exact relation to the fruit live.
Calling or requesting supplies responsive agency inside the Garden scene.
Purposive work recurs with an explicitly divine source, redistributing productive agency.
The hand as power marks effective divine production rather than human manufacture.
Possession and disposal show recipients exercising real use over what they did not originate.

structural_cues: 36:35 can connect mā either positively or negatively to the work of their hands; the packet does not settle that syntactic alternative.
36:57 gives the Garden's companions fruit and what they call for, while 36:71 distinguishes divine production from human possession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring work, hands, yield, request, and possession; I infer a model of recipient agency nested within provision. The live alternatives are that 36:35 credits human cultivation, denies it, or that these worldly production scenes do not specify afterlife shughul at all.

changed_reading.before: The companions passively consume a finished reward.
changed_reading.after: They exercise responsive agency within provision, enjoying, requesting, and using without being represented as the ultimate source of what sustains the enjoyment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers physical covering and judicial separation into an attentional mechanism. It remains anchored in j-n-n as cover or shield and shughul as an absorbing distraction, with barriers, shade, and separation as packet support. Downstream prose should present it as a spatial-psychological analogy, not as a claim that the verse explicitly says the companions are unaware of others.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Jannah can shield or conceal, while fī shughulin can absorb attention away from something else.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the boundary that keeps an outside condition from immediate view.
A protective shield turns the Garden boundary into refuge rather than mere hiddenness.
An occupation that distracts supplies the proposed attentional interior.
Barriers before and behind provide an earlier, negative architecture of enclosed perception.
A covering laid over perception supplies the negative counterpart to protected concealment.
Protective shade gives the focus enclosure an immediate positive spatial realization.
Explicit sorting supplies the boundary between the companions' interior and the opposed judgment scene.

changed_reading.before: They are busy with pleasures while judgment happens nearby.
changed_reading.after: Their delighted absorption may itself function as a protected attentional interior after separation, with the Garden shielding the experiential field from the surrounding crisis.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because neither Garden nor fākihūn ordinarily requires a gestational reading. It remains traceable through j-n-n's hidden fetus, f-k-h's pre-birth milk, and the packet's sperm, origination, and resurrection sequence. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy of maturation and emergence, never a direct lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins j-n-n, whose inventory includes the hidden fetus, to f-k-h, whose inventory includes milk appearing before birth.

activation_trace.role: The fetus hidden in the womb supplies a concealed life awaiting emergence.
Milk appearing and thickening before birth supplies a material image of ripeness at the edge of emergence.
Stirring the still from repose supplies the resurrection transition into manifested life.
The generative drop supplies the surah's explicit small and concealed beginning of human life.
Bringing a thing into being supplies the creative arrow from hidden beginning to renewed existence.

changed_reading.before: The companions occupy a static post-resurrection reward.
changed_reading.after: Their Garden delight can be carried as a maturation image: concealed life has crossed resurrection into a newly manifest, fruit-bearing mode of existence.

strongest_changes: Repeated al-yawm turns temporal deixis into an enacted partition of recompensed conditions.
The paired shade-and-couch scene revises shughul from exertion into engrossing shared repose.
The immediate fākihūn/fākihah echo literalizes delight as fruitive enjoyment, while the following utterance of peace adds a receptive verbal dimension.
The earlier companions-of-town construction and the individual entry into the Garden make companions-of-Garden a culminating place-defined collective identity.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made same-root recurrences of ṣ-ḥ-b, j-n-n, y-w-m, and f-k-h interact with distant resurrection, provision, and creation sequences; the focus changed most when those recurrences specified the otherwise objectless shughul.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether fākihūn is best heard as an additional predicate, a circumstantial state, or both affects how tightly delight is bound to shughul.
The relation of mā to the work of hands in 36:35 remains live and limits confidence in the provisioned-agency model.
The peaceful address may crown the companions' occupation without constituting its verbal content, and the gestational model remains analogical only.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Judgment-day occupation becomes delighted freedom.** `ص ح ب` B001 companionship; `ج ن ن` B003 garden; `ي و م` B003 event-day; `ش غ ل` B001 preoccupation opposite freedom; `ف ك ه` B001 delighted enjoyment. Their *occupation* is paradoxically enjoyment rather than anxious labor. I infer that judgment has removed competing burdens, allowing delight to fill attention. The ayah reads as absorbed ease.
2. **Garden companionship answers isolated accountability.** 36:54 addressed each `ن ف س` B011, while this ayah names plural companions. I infer that exact individual recompense enables, rather than erases, restored sociality. The fixed ayah reads as communal outcome after personal accounting.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 36:56-58 showed how absorbed delight is structured by spouse, shelter, responsive provision, and peace; *occupation* became a dense positive ecology rather than mere distraction.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Preoccupation becomes freedom from competing demand.** **ص ح ب B001** anchors sustained association in **أَصْحَٰبَ**; **ج ن ن B003** the covered garden; **ش غ ل B001** occupation as the opposite of free attention; and **ف ك ه B001** pleasant ease and delight. Matching recompense precedes (36:54), while spouses, shade, fruit, and peace specify the occupation in 36:56–58. Those packet elements are supplied; the inferred arrow is *once liability is settled, attention can be wholly occupied by an internally coherent field of delight*. **شُغُلٍ** reads as absorbed sufficiency, not burdensome distraction.
2. **Companionship is part of the reward mechanism.** **ص ح ب B004** supplies making things accompany and fit, while **ف ك ه B003** permits pleasant social talk. Spouses and shared reclining follow in 36:56. The packet supplies company and fitted co-presence; the abduction is *delight is generated relationally through companions fitted to a protected environment*. The garden's “companions” are not merely residents.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: **Later surprise.** 36:56–58 specifies the occupation as nested support, effective access, and spoken peace; 36:59 then separates offenders. Delight is therefore not vague distraction but a protected field whose coherence depends on exclusion of the relation that would disrupt it.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin başka bir şeyle yakın ve süreğen biçimde birlikte bulunmasını çekirdek anlam olarak verir. Kişi, hayvan, yer ve zamanla kurulan eşlik ilişkisi bu çekirdeğe girerken sahiplik, bir işin başında bulunma ve yanında bir eşlikçi bulunması belirli yapılara bağlı uzantılardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Geçici bir karşılaşma yeterli değildir; anlam, görece sürekli eşlik veya yakın birliktelik gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eşlik çekirdeği ile sahiplik, görev ve bir eşlikçisi bulunma gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımları ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi ya da şeyle geçici olmayan biçimde birlikte bulunmak, ona eşlik etmek veya onunla yakınlığını sürdürmektir. Belirli yapılarda bir şeyin sahibi ya da sorumlusu olmayı ve kişinin yanında bir eşlikçi bulunmasını da anlatır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, iki tarafın yakın ve süreğen biçimde birlikte bulunması ya da birinin ötekine eşlik etmesidir.
Eşlik eden taraf kişi, hayvan, yer veya zamanla ilişkili olabilir; tekil eşlikçi ve eşlikçiler topluluğu da adlandırılabilir.
Belirli ad tamlamalarında bir şeyin sahibi, ona bağlı kişi veya onun işini yürüten sorumlu kastedilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi korunmak için arkasına sığınılan silah veya örtüyü genel çekirdek, kalkanı ve zırhı ise belirgin gerçekleşmeler olarak verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal koruyucu siper veya savaş donanımıyla sınırlıdır; bahçe, akıl yitimi ve sıradan örtü anlamlarına genişlemez.

facets.statement: Bir örtü veya savaş donanımı kişiyi tehlikeden koruyan siper işlevi görür.
Kalkan ve zırh, koruyucu siper çekirdeğinin açık araç türleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar korunmak için kullanılan örtü veya silah çekirdeğinde birleşir ve özellikle kalkan ile zırhı bu kapsamda anar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kalkan, zırh ya da kişinin arkasına sığınıp kendini koruduğu başka bir savaş örtüsü için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Koruma işlevini, siper niteliğini ve kalkan ile zırh gibi araç kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kaynak biçim özellikle elde taşınan koruyucu savaş aracını gösterdiğinde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Elde taşınan siper aracını ve sahibini koruma işlevini tam olarak korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle savaşta giyilen zırhı ve giyilebilir koruyucu donanımı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da savaşta bedeni saldırıdan koruyan araç ve donanımları bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kalkan gibi giyilmeyen siperleri de kapsar; komşu ise giyilebilir zırh ve korunma giysisine daha sıkı bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ölüyü örterek gözden kaldırma ve gömme eylemini, gömütü, ölü örtüsünü ve gömülmüş kişiyi aynı dalda açıkça kaydeder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ölü ve gömme alanındadır; anne rahmindeki doğmamış çocuk anlamıyla yalnızca biçim benzerliği paylaşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın gömme ve ölü örtme dalını kapsar; genel çukur açma veya doğmamış çocuk anlamına genişletilmez.

facets.statement: Ölü örtülerek gözden kaldırılır ve toprağa gömülür.
Gömüt, ölü örtüsü ve gömülmüş kişi aynı işlemin sırasıyla yer, araç ve sonuç katılımcılarını adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ölüyü örtüp gömme eyleminde birleşir; aynı biçim alanında gömüt, ölü örtüsü ve gömülmüş kişi yorumlarını da verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ölünün gözden kaldırılarak toprağa verilmesini ve bu işlemin örtme yönünü birlikte anlatan bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ölü katılımcısını, örtme işlemini ve gömme sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Örtme ayrıntısının gömme eyleminden doğal olarak anlaşıldığı akıcı anlatımlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ölü katılımcısını ve gömerek gözden kaldırma işlemini bağlam içinde korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın içte saklı yürek ve gizli yön anlamlarını kapsar; başka söz öbeklerinden anlam aktarmaz.

facets.statement: Yürek ve onun korkuyla sarsılan iç yönü bedende duyulardan saklıdır.
Bir işin gizli veya görünmeyen yanı, içte saklı olma özelliğinden türeyen soyut kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar duyulardan saklı yürek anlamında birleşir; bir kaynak aynı biçimi gizli iş ve görünmeyen yön için de kaydeder.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bitkinin güçlenme, boy atma, sıklaşıp birbirine dolaşma veya çiçek açma gelişimini; uzun ağaç ve bol otlu arazi sonuçlarını da buna bağlı biçimde verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bitki gelişimi ve yoğunluğuyla sınırlıdır; böcek sesi veya sırf ağaçlı bahçe adı bu çekirdeğe girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın bitki gelişimi dalını korur ve böcek sesine bağlı kullanımı ya da başka dalların yer adlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Bitkinin güçlenmesi, boy atması, sıklaşıp birbirine dolaşması veya çiçek açmasıdır; uzun ağaç ve bol, otlanmamış bitki örtüsü bu gelişimin sonuç odaklı görünümleridir.

facets.statement: Bitki güçlenir, boy atar, sıklaşıp dolaşır veya çiçek açarak gelişimini belirginleştirir.
Uzun ağaç ile yoğun ve bol otlu arazi, bitkisel gelişimin sonuç veya alan odaklı uzantılarıdır.
Bol otlu arazi kullanımında bitki örtüsünün henüz otlanmamış olması ayrıca belirtilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bitkinin güçlenmesi, uzaması, sıklaşması ve çiçeklenmesi çevresinde birleşir; uzun ağaç ile bol ve otlanmamış araziyi sonuç olarak ekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bitkinin gelişerek uzadığı, yoğunlaştığı, birbirine dolaştığı veya çiçek açtığı genel bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Güçlenme, boylanma, sıklaşma ve ileri gelişim aşamalarını seçenekli bir süreç olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bahçe, vadi veya ufuk gibi bir alanın yoğun bitki örtüsüyle kaplandığı bağlamlarda doğaldır.

Gençliğin veya çocukluğun ilk dönemi bu genel başlangıç evresinin belirgin örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gençlik ve çocukluk örneklerinden hareketle anlamı herhangi bir şeyin ilk başlangıç ve yenilik dönemine geneller.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyin ilk ve yeni dönemi

error_profile.preserves: İlk olmayı, başlangıç evresini ve henüz yeni bulunma niteliğini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sineğin sesinin çoğalmasını açıkça destekler, ancak ikinci biçimin hem uçarken çok ses çıkaran bir böceğe hem de sıklaşan bir bitkiye yorumlanabileceğini söyler; dal yalnızca böcek yorumu altında ses dalıdır.

İki yorumlu ad böceği gösterirse uçuş sesi, bitkiyi gösterirse sıklaşıp dolaşma anlamına gelir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sineğin sesinin çoğalmasını verir; iki yorumlu adın böcek okumasında uçuş vızıltısı, bitki okumasında ise sıklaşma bildirdiğini ayrıca belirtir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sinek veya benzeri küçük uçucu canlının çıkardığı sesin çoğalması eylem olarak anlatıldığında doğaldır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın kimliği, kaynak sözündeki boşta olmanın karşıtı çekirdeğine uygundur. Kaynak sözü ayrıca birini uğraş içine sokmayı, bir şeyle uğraşır duruma gelmeyi, insanın zihnini kaplayan olayı ve uğraşın alıkoyuculuğunu pekiştiren söyleyişi aynı çekirdeğe bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Boşta olmanın karşıtı olarak zamanın ve zihnin bir iş ya da etken tarafından kaplanmasıdır. Bu çekirdek, birini uğraş içine sokmayı, bir şeyle uğraşır duruma gelmeyi ve insanı çevresinden habersiz bırakabilen alıkoyucu olayı kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel durum, kişinin boşta olmaması ve zamanının bir uğraşla dolu bulunmasıdır.
Uğraş, insanın zihnini kaplayıp onu çevresinden habersiz bırakabilen bir olay ya da etken olarak da adlandırılır.
Geçişli kullanımda bir kişi ya da etken, başkasını uğraş içine sokarak onun boşta kalmasını önler.
Bir şeyle uğraşır durumda olma, o şeyin kişinin zamanını ya da zihnini kaplaması biçiminde kurulur.
Pekiştirmeli söyleyiş, uğraşın uğraş olma niteliğini özellikle vurgular.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin neşeli, güler yüzlü ve hoşnut olması; içinde bulunduğu iyi durumdan memnuniyet duymasıdır. Belirli kuruluşlarda bir şeyden zevk alarak yararlanmayı veya yiyeceği tat alarak tüketmeyi de anlatır.

facets.statement: Kişi içi hoş, güler yüzlü ve şakalaşmaya yatkın bir ruh durumundadır.
Kişi içinde bulunduğu bolluk ve rahatlıktan hoşnut olur, elindekileri beğenir.
Belirli bir şeyle kurulduğunda ondan tat alarak yararlanmayı ve keyif duymayı anlatır.
Yiyeceği veya meyveyi zevk alarak tüketmek, yararlanma anlamının özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, neşeli ve hoş bir ruh durumunu merkeze alır; buna güler yüzlülük ve şakacılık eşlik edebilir. Aynı anlam alanı, içinde bulunulan iyi durumdan memnun olmayı ve belirli bir şeyin tadını çıkararak ondan yararlanmayı da kapsar.

Bu yüzden dal kimliği korunabilir, fakat kapsam ayrılığı açıkça belirtilmelidir.

concept_map.definition: Yenmesi hoş bulunan ve değer verilen meyve ile meyve türlerini anlatır. Kapsamı bir görüşte bütün meyveleri içerirken, başka bir görüş üzüm ile narı bu adın dışında tutar; türemiş kullanımlar meyve sunma, satma veya tat alarak yeme eylemlerini bildirir.

facets.statement: Yenmesi hoş bulunan, değer verilen meyve ve meyve türleri adlandırılır.

Daha dar bir görüş, üzüm ile narı bu sınıfın dışında tutar.
Türemiş biçimler meyve sunmayı, meyve satmayı ve meyveyi tat alarak yemeyi anlatır.

Diğer yorumlar, kullanımı şakayla uğraşma veya meyve yeme biçiminde çözümler.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kendini beğenmiş, ölçüyü aşan ve kınanan şımarıklığı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın kanıtı genel bir olumsuz niteleme düzeyindedir; komşu dal şımarıklığı özellikle bolluk karşısında azma ve nimeti hor görme koşuluyla ayrıntılandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişinin yerleşik veya bağlamsal şımarık, küstah tutumunu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sevincin haksız ve ölçüsüz bir taşkınlığa dönüşmesini başlangıç noktası olarak taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kınanan, ölçüsüz ve taşkın bir duygu ya da davranışta kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın çekirdeği şımarık küstahlıktır; komşu dal ise bu olumsuzluğu sevincin yanlış biçimde taşmasına bağlar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الفكه أو فكهين بمعنى الأشر البطر، خاصة في مقابلة نعيم أهل الجنة عند بعض النصوص.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiyle veya insanların saygınlığıyla kurulan belirli yapılarda o kişinin arkasından konuşmayı, onu sözle çekiştirip değerini düşürmeyi açıkça anlatır. Sağlanan çerçeve bu kuruluş bağımlı anlamı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel şaka veya eğlence değildir; yalnız kişi ya da insanların saygınlığıyla kurulan yapılarda, yokluklarında kötüleyici söz söylemeyi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız kişi veya insanların saygınlığıyla kurulan belirtilmiş yapılara bağlıdır; yiyecekten zevk alma ya da yalın şakalaşma anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir kişi veya insanların saygınlığı hakkında, yokluklarında onları kötüleyip çekiştiren ve değerlerini düşüren sözler söylemektir. Anlam, kişi ya da saygınlık bildiren tamamlayıcıyla kurulan özel söz dizisine bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Konuşan, bir kişinin yokluğunda onun hakkında kötüleyici ve incitici söz söyler.
Söz, kişinin veya bir topluluğun saygınlığını hedef alır ve değerini düşürür.
Bu anlam kişi ya da insanların saygınlığıyla kurulan özel söz dizisinde ortaya çıkar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek tanıklık, kişi veya insanların saygınlığıyla kurulan yapıda, onların yokluğunda haklarında kötüleyici söz söylemeyi ve onları çekiştirerek değerlerini düşürmeyi anlatır. Yiyecekten tat alma kullanımıyla aynı kalıp içinde anılsa da anlamı kişi hedefi belirler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin yokluğunu, kötüleyici konuşmayı ve saygınlığı zedeleyen sözlü yönelmeyi doğal biçimde karşılar.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişinin yokluğunda iyi ya da kötü anılabildiğine ilişkin daha geniş bir aktarımı da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişinin yokluğunda onun hakkında, özellikle kusurunu söyleyerek konuşmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kuruluş bağımlı biçimde kötüleme ve saygınlığa saldırıyı gerektirir; komşu dal yoklukta anmayı daha genel kurar ve bazı aktarımlarda iyi sözü de kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsanları kusurlarıyla hedef alan kötüleyici konuşmayı belirli bir söz kalıbına bağlı olmadan anlatır.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو الفكاهة المباحة أو مطلق المزاح، ولا مجرد التمتع بالطعام أو الفاكهة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: يتفكه بالطعام أو بالفاكهة أو بأعراض الناس؛ تركت القوم يتفكهون بفلان أي يغتابونه ويتناولون منه؛ الفكه الذي ينال من أعراض الناس (tahdhib)

root_profile.summary: Kök, yenmesi hoş meyveden neşeli hoşnutluğa, tatlı sözlerle şakalaşmadan bir şeyin tadını çıkarmaya uzanan birkaç ilişkili dal taşır; ayrıca doğum öncesi sütlenme, kınanan şımarıklık ve kişi hakkında kötüleyici konuşma gibi ayrışmış kullanımları vardır. Şaşırma ile pişmanlık arasında kalan bir kullanımın hem anlamı hem de kök üyeliği yapısal inceleme gerektirir.
